refused.why: a ratio, a difference or a share. 60.9 is a SEGMENT's orders and 47.0 is the WHOLE COMPANY's revenue for the quarter, so every arithmetic relation between them is meaningless. They are drawn in two separately bevelled fields with a deep uncut gutter between them, no shared baseline, no axis, no bracket and no tick, and the only sentence tying them says the larger figure is the smaller thing.

an orders-to-revenue conversion rate. Both numerals sit in one quote and only 60.9 reaches a frame, because a segment's booked orders and its recognized revenue are different quantities in different periods.

a day count. The interval is DRAWN as built extent on slide 4, one masonry block per day at a constant rate, and no numeral for it is printed anywhere in the deck. The drawing carries the quantity so nothing has to assert it in type.
a cause. The listing gives no reason for the cancellation, slide 3 says so and names where it looked, and nothing in the deck asserts that one row explains the other.
